paite: Ngai un, TOUPA khut hondam thei lou ding in tomsak in a-om kei a; abil leng za thei lou ding in angong sam kei.
heading: Zawlnei In Mipite Khelhna Amohpaih
english: Behold, Yahweh’s hand is not shortened, that it can’t save; nor his ear dull, that it can’t hear.

paite: Na thulimlouhnate uh noumau leh na Pathian kal ua kia in ahon khen ahi, bil a azak noplouhna ding in na khelhnate un amai ahon liahsak ahi.
english: But your iniquities have separated you and your God, and your sins have hidden his face from you, so that he will not hear.

paite: Na khutte uh lah sisan a hihnit in a-om a, na khutzungte uh lah thulimlouhna a hihnit in a-om hi; na mukte un zuau agen a, na lei uh ginatlouhna thu gen in aphun nuanua hi.
english: For your hands are defiled with blood, and your fingers with iniquity. Your lips have spoken lies. Your tongue mutters wickedness.

paite: Kuama'n diktak in thukhawk agen kei ua, kuama'n thutak in thu agenpih ngei kei uh; huihkhua lelte amuang ua, zuau agen nak uhi; thilhihkhelhna apai ua, thulimlouhna asuang zel uhi.
english: No one sues in righteousness, and no one pleads in truth. They trust in vanity and speak lies. They conceive mischief and give birth to iniquity.

paite: Thangtom tuite a-opkhum ua, maimom gil puan agan uh; atui ne mite asi uhi, hihtap a om ah gul ahong pawt hi.
english: They hatch adders’ eggs and weave the spider’s web. He who eats of their eggs dies; and that which is crushed breaks out into a viper.

paite: Amaimon gil puante uh puansilh ding in ahong om kei ding a, athilhihte uh leng asilh sam kei ding uh; athilhihte uh lah thulimlouhna thilhihte ahi a, hiamgamtak a hihna akhut uah a-om hi.
english: Their webs won’t become garments. They won’t cover themselves with their works. Their works are works of iniquity, and acts of violence are in their hands.

paite: Akhete uh thil hoih lou lam ah atai a, gensiatbei sisan suah ding in akintat nilouh ua; angaihtuahte uh lah thulimlouhna ngaihtuahnate ahi a; gamna leh siatna alampite uah a-om zel hi.
english: Their feet run to evil, and they hurry to shed innocent blood. Their thoughts are thoughts of iniquity. Desolation and destruction are in their paths.

paite: Lungmuanna lampi athei kei ua; apaina uah dikna himhim a-om ngei kei; amau a ding in lam kawi bang abawl ua; huai lai a pai peuhmah in lungmuanna athei ngei kei uh.
english: They don’t know the way of peace; and there is no justice in their ways. They have made crooked paths for themselves; whoever goes in them doesn’t know peace.

paite: Huaiziak in vaihawmna ei a kipan gamlapi ah a-om naknak a, diktatna in ahon phazou ngei kei; vak i ngak ua, himahleh, ngai in, mial ahong hi a; vakna i ngak ua, himahleh mial bikbek mah ah i pai uhi.
heading: Mipite'n Akhelhna Uh Apuang uh
english: Therefore justice is far from us, and righteousness doesn’t overtake us. We look for light, but see darkness; for brightness, but we walk in obscurity.

paite: Mittaw bang in baang i mai puampuam ua, ahi, mit neiloute bang in i mai puampuam uhi; khomial tung bang in sun lai in i kisui ua; mihatte lak ah misi bang phet i hi uhi.
english: We grope for the wall like the blind. Yes, we grope as those who have no eyes. We stumble at noon as if it were twilight. Among those who are strong, we are like dead men.

paite: Vompite bang in i vek un i ham dupdup ua, vakhute bang in nakpitak in i thum ngutngut uh; vaihawmna i ngak ua, himahleh, a-om het kei hi; hotdamna i ngak ua, himahleh gamlapi ah ahon omsan hi.
english: We all roar like bears and moan sadly like doves. We look for justice, but there is none, for salvation, but it is far off from us.

paite: I tatleknate uh na ma ah akhangta a, i khelhnate'n ahon hek gige hi; i kiang ua i tatleknate uh a-om gige ziak in, i thulimlouhnate uh i thei uhi.
english: For our transgressions are multiplied before you, and our sins testify against us; for our transgressions are with us, and as for our iniquities, we know them:

paite: I takleknate, TOUPA i theihmohbawlte, i Pathian i zuih louh a i kiheisante, nuaisiah thu leh hel thu i gente, zuau thu i pai ua, lungtang a kipan i genkhiak zelte.
english: transgressing and denying Yahweh, and turning away from following our God, speaking oppression and revolt, conceiving and uttering from the heart words of falsehood.

paite: Huchi in vaihawmna in nunglam ahon ngatsan a, diktatna in gamlapi ah ahon dinsanta; thutak lah kongzing ah apuk a, dikna alut thei kei hi.
english: Justice is turned away backward, and righteousness stands far away; for truth has fallen in the street, and uprightness can’t enter.

paite: Ahi, thutak a-omta kei a; thil hoih lou tawpsanmi gallak in akibawl zel. Huchi in TOUPA'N huai amu a, thudik a vaihawmna himhim a-om louh ziak in alungkimsakta kei hi.
heading: Amite Honkhe Ding In TOUPA Akisa
english: Yes, truth is lacking; and he who departs from evil makes himself a prey. Yahweh saw it, and it displeased him that there was no justice.

paite: Huan mi kuamah a-om kei chih athei a, ngetsakmi mawngmawng a-om louh uh lamdang asa a; huaiziak in amah ban mahmah in hotdamna akibawl a; amah diktatna mah in akilenkip hi.
english: He saw that there was no man, and wondered that there was no intercessor. Therefore his own arm brought salvation to him; and his righteousness sustained him.

paite: Diktatna lum in anei a, hotdamna lukhu akhu a; puansilh in phulakna puansilhte asilh a, puanaktual ding in phatuamngaihna asilh hi.
english: He put on righteousness as a breastplate, and a helmet of salvation on his head. He put on garments of vengeance for clothing, and was clad with zeal as a mantle.

paite: Athilhihte uh bang in, athilhihte uh bang in ama'n athuk ding, amah dou mite hehna in, amelmate thukna in athuk ding; tuikulh gamte thukna in athuk ding.
english: According to their deeds, he will repay as appropriate: wrath to his adversaries, recompense to his enemies. He will repay the islands their due.

paite: Huchi in tumlam a kipan TOUPA min alau ding ua, athupina leng nisuahna a kipan in alau ding uh; tui khang bang a melma ahong pai chiang in, TOUPA Kha in amah dou in alamang ding hi.
english: So they will fear Yahweh’s name from the west, and his glory from the rising of the sun; for he will come as a rushing stream, which Yahweh’s breath drives.

paite: "Zion ah Tanpa in ahong pai ding a, Jakobte lak a tatlekna tawpsan mite lak ah leng ahong pai ding, TOUPA'N achi.
english: “A Redeemer will come to Zion, and to those who turn from disobedience in Jacob,” says Yahweh.

paite: Ke'n zaw, hiai ahi akiang ua ka thukhun,” TOUPA'N achi. “Ka kha na tung a omleh, na kam a thu ka koihte'n, tuban tangtawn pha in na kam apawtsan kei ding ua, na suante kam leng apawtsan sam kei ding ua, na tusuan sawnte kam leng apawtsan sam kei ding uh," TOUPA'N achi.
english: “As for me, this is my covenant with them,” says Yahweh. “My Spirit who is on you, and my words which I have put in your mouth shall not depart out of your mouth, nor out of the mouth of your offspring, nor out of the mouth of your offspring’s offspring,” says Yahweh, “from now on and forever.”
